summary: Save now shows which dependent objects it would refresh and waits for your confirmation before writing anything.
details: Choosing Save asks ArcRho Engine which datasets and methods the save can reach, then lists them by name and type; nothing is written until you choose Save and update, and Cancel leaves your edit untouched in the window.
A save that reaches no dependent objects skips the question entirely and saves straight through.
The list is what the save can reach, so some objects may turn out to already be up to date; the notice after the save still names exactly what was refreshed.
If someone else changes the same reserving class while the list is on screen, the save is refused with a clear message and nothing is written, so you can review the current list and save again.
